info.description: Prototype under reconstruction. Labels the most recent matching news headline (the provider is asked for one article per query) with a keyword-baseline flag. Nothing is ranked or sorted. Every result is a flag for human review, not a verdict on whether a claim is true. Every response carries provenance (synthetic, data_as_of, source_status). Synthetic demo data is served only when DEMO_MODE=true and is labelled synthetic: true.
info.title: TruthTrail API
